verses.geez: ወተመየጥኩ፡ አነ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ትዕግልተ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ እምታሕተ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: So I returned, and saw all the oppressions that were done under the sun: and behold the tear of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of them that oppressed them was power; but they had no comforter:

translations.lxx: So I returned, and saw all the oppressions that were done under the sun: and behold the tear of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of them that oppressed them was power; but they had no comforter:
translations.kjv: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
translations.ron: Şi iarăşi am luat aminte la toate silniciile care se săvârşesc sub soare. Şi iată lacrimile celor apăsaţi şi nimeni nu era care să-i mângâie, iar în mâna celor silnici toată asuprirea şi nici un mângâietor nu se găsea!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα ἐγὼ, καὶ εἶδον συμπάσας τὰς συκοφαντίας τὰς γενομένας ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον· καὶ ἰδοὺ δάκρυον τῶν συκοφαντουμένων, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς παρακαλῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ χειρὸς συκοφαντούντων αὐτοῖς ἰσχὺς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς παρακαλῶν.

verses.geez: ወናሁ፡ አንብዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ እለ፡ ይትዔገልዎሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይናዝዞሙ፡ እምእለ፡ ይትዔገልዎሙ፡ በኃይል።
verses.translation: and I praised all the dead that had already died more than the living, as many as are alive until now.

translations.lxx: and I praised all the dead that had already died more than the living, as many as are alive until now.
translations.kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
translations.ron: Şi am fericit pe cei ce au murit în vremi străvechi mai mult decât pe cei vii care sunt acum în viaţă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπῄνεσα ἐγὼ σύμπαντας τοὺς τεθνηκότας τοὺς ἤδη ἀποθανόντας ὑπὲρ τοὺς ζῶντας, ὅσοι αὐτοὶ ζῶσιν ἕως τοῦ νῦν.

verses.geez: ወአስተኃየስክዎሙ፡ አነ፡ ለእለ፡ ሞቱ፡ ኅቡረ፡ እለ፡ ወድኡ፡ ሞተ፡ እምሕያዋን፡ ወእለ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ሕያዋን፡ እስከ፡ ይእዜ።
verses.translation: Better also than both these is he who has not yet been, who has not seen all the evil work that is done under the sun.

translations.lxx: Better also than both these is he who has not yet been, who has not seen all the evil work that is done under the sun.
translations.kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
translations.ron: Iar mai fericit şi decât unii şi decât alţii este cel ce n-a venit pe lume, cel care n-a văzut faptele cele rele care se săvârşesc sub soare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀγαθὸς ὑπὲρ τοὺς δύο τούτους ὅστις οὔπω ἐγένετο, ὃς οὐκ εἶδε σὺν πᾶν τὸ ποίημα τὸ πονηρὸν τὸ πεποιημένον ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: ወእምክልኤሆሙ፡ ይኄይስ፡ ዳሕፅ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ኢተፈጥሮ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ ገቢረ፡ እከይ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: And I saw all labour, and all the diligent work, that this is a man's envy from his neighbour. This is also vanity and waywardness of spirit.

translations.lxx: And I saw all labour, and all the diligent work, that this is a man's envy from his neighbour. This is also vanity and waywardness of spirit.
translations.kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: Şi am văzut că toată strădania şi toată izbânda omului la lucru nu este decât pizma unuia faţă de altul. Şi aceasta este deşertăciune şi vânare de vânt!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον ἐγὼ σύμπαντα τὸν μόχθον, καὶ σύμπασαν ἀνδρίαν τοῦ ποιήματος, ὅτι αὐτὸ ζῆλος ἀνδρὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἑταίρου αὐτοῦ· καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος.

verses.geez: ወርኢኩ፡ አነ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥራኀ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ኃይለ፡ ምግባር፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቅንእ፡ ለብእሲ፡ እምኀበ፡ ቢጹ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: The fool folds his hands together, and eats his own flesh.

translations.lxx: The fool folds his hands together, and eats his own flesh.
translations.kjv: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
translations.ron: Nebunul stă cu mâinile în sân şi îşi mănâncă singur timpul zicând:
translations.grk: Ὁ ἄφρων περιέβαλε τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔφαγε τὰς σάρκας αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Better is a handful of rest than two handfuls of trouble and waywardness of spirit.

translations.lxx: Better is a handful of rest than two handfuls of trouble and waywardness of spirit.
translations.kjv: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: "Mai de preţ este un pumn plin de odihnă decât doi pumni plini de trudă şi de vânare de vânt".
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὸν πλήρωμα δρακὸς ἀναπαύσεως ὑπὲρ πληρώματα δύο δρακῶν μόχθου καὶ προαιρέσεως πνεύματος.

verses.geez: ሠናይ፡ ምልአ፡ እደ፡ በጽድቅ፡ እምነ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ሕፍን፡ ዘበዓመፃ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: So I returned, and saw vanity under the sun.

translations.lxx: So I returned, and saw vanity under the sun.
translations.kjv: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
translations.ron: Şi iarăşi am văzut o nepotrivire sub soare:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα ἐγὼ, καὶ εἶδον ματαιότητα ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: ወተመየጥኩ፡ አነ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ ከንቶ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he has neither son nor brother: yet there is no end to all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with wealth; and for whom do I labour, and deprive my soul of good? this is also vanity, and an evil trouble.

translations.lxx: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he has neither son nor brother: yet there is no end to all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with wealth; and for whom do I labour, and deprive my soul of good? this is also vanity, and an evil trouble.
translations.kjv: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
translations.ron: Este câte un om care este stingher şi care nu are nici copil, nici frate şi totuşi lucrul nu-l mai sfârşeşte şi ochii lui nu se mai satură de bogăţie. Dar vine o vreme când zice: "Pentru cine m-am trudit şi am lipsit sufletul meu de traiul cel bun?" Şi aceasta este deşertăciune şi rea îndeletnicire.
translations.grk: Ἔστιν εἷς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι δεύτερος· καί γε υἱὸς καί γε ἀδελφὸς οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ· καὶ οὐκ ἔστι περασμὸς τῷ παντὶ μόχθῳ αὐτοῦ· καί γε ὀφθαλμὸς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐμπίμπλαται πλούτου· καὶ τίνι ἐγὼ μοχθῶ, καὶ στερίσκω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ ἀγαθωσύνης; καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ περισπασμὸς πονηρός ἐστιν.

verses.geez: ወሀሎ፡ አሐዱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ካልእ፡ ወልድ፡ ወእኊ፡ አልቦ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ሥራሑ፡ ወዓይኑሂ፡ ኢይመልእ፡ ብዕለ፡ ወኢይቤ፡ ለመኑ፡ እሠርኅ፡ አነ፡ ወእቄቅያ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ እምብዕል፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወሥራኅ፡ እኩይ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: Two are better than one, seeing they have a good reward for their labour.

translations.lxx: Two are better than one, seeing they have a good reward for their labour.
translations.kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
translations.ron: Mai fericiţi sunt doi laolaltă decât unul, fiindcă au răsplată bună pentru munca lor;
translations.grk: Ἀγαθοὶ οἱ δύο ὑπὲρ τὸν ἕνα, οἷς ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς μισθὸς ἀγαθὸς ἐν μόχθῳ αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ይኄይሱ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ እምአሐዱ፡ እለ፡ ቦሙ፡ ዐስብ፡ ሠናይ፡ በፃማሆሙ።
verses.translation: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falls, and there is not a second to lift him up.

translations.lxx: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falls, and there is not a second to lift him up.
translations.kjv: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
translations.ron: Căci dacă unul cade, îl scoală tovarăşul lui. Dar vai de cel singur care cade şi nu este cel de-al doilea ca să-l ridice!
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐὰν πέσωσιν, ὁ εἷς ἐγερεῖ τὸν μέτοχον αὐτοῦ· καὶ οὐαὶ αὐτῷ τῷ ἑνὶ, ὅταν πέσῃ καὶ μὴ ᾖ δεύτερος ἐγεῖραι αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እመ፡ ወድቀ፡ አሐዱ፡ ያነሥኦ፡ ካልኡ፡ አሌ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለአሐዱ፡ እመ፡ ወድቀ፡ አልቦ፡ ካልእ፡ ዘያነሥኦ።
verses.translation: Also if two should lie together, they also get heat: but how shall one be warmed alone?

translations.lxx: Also if two should lie together, they also get heat: but how shall one be warmed alone?
translations.kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
translations.ron: Asemenea când doi se culcă se încălzesc, iar unul cum s-ar putea încălzi?
translations.grk: Καί γε ἐὰν κοιμηθῶσι δύο, καὶ θέρμη αὐτοῖς, καὶ ὁ εἷς πῶς θερμανθῇ;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እመ፡ ኖሙ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ይትማወቁ፡ ወአሐዱሰ፡ እፎ፡ ይትማወቅ።
verses.translation: And if one should prevail against him, the two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord shall not be quickly broken.

translations.lxx: And if one should prevail against him, the two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord shall not be quickly broken.
translations.kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
translations.ron: Şi dacă unul este luat fără de veste, cel de-al doilea sare pentru el; căci sfoara pusă în trei nu se rupe degrabă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐὰν ἐπικραταιωθῇ ὁ εἷς, οἱ δύο στήσονται κατέναντι αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ σπαρτίον τὸ ἔντριτον οὐ ταχέως ἀποῤῥαγήσεται.

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ ፀንዐ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ይትቃወምዎ፡ ወፈትል፡ ሥሉስ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ኢይትበተክ።
verses.translation: Better is a poor and wise child than an old and foolish king, who knows not how to take heed any longer.

translations.lxx: Better is a poor and wise child than an old and foolish king, who knows not how to take heed any longer.
translations.kjv: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
translations.ron: Mai de preţ este un copil sărman şi înţelept decât un rege bătrân şi nebun, care nu mai este în stare să asculte de sfaturi;
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὸς παῖς πένης καὶ σοφὸς ὑπὲρ βασιλέα πρεσβύτερον καὶ ἄφρονα, ὃς οὐκ ἔγνω τοῦ προσέχειν ἔτι·

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ቅኑይ፡ ነዳይ፡ ወጠቢብ፡ እምንጉሥ፡ ልሂቅ፡ ወዐብድ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ ለነጽሮ፡ ከመ፡ እምቤተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ለነጊሥ፡ እስመ፡ በመንግሥቱ፡ ኮነ፡ ነዳየ።
verses.translation: For he shall come forth out of the house of the prisoners to reign, because he also that was in his kingdom has become poor.

translations.lxx: For he shall come forth out of the house of the prisoners to reign, because he also that was in his kingdom has become poor.
translations.kjv: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
translations.ron: Căci el poate să iasă din închisoare ca să domnească, deşi s-a născut sărac în ţara celuilalt.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐξ οἴκου τῶν δεσμίων ἐξελεύσεται τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι, ὅτι καί γε ἐν βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐγενήθη πένης.

verses.geez: ወርኢኩ፡ አነ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅቡረ፡ እለ፡ ሕያዋን፡ እለ፡ ያንሶስዉ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ምሳሌ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ካልእ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ ይትነሣእ።
verses.translation: I beheld all the living who were walking under the sun, with the second youth who shall stand up in each one's place.

translations.lxx: I beheld all the living who were walking under the sun, with the second youth who shall stand up in each one's place.
translations.kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
translations.ron: Văzut-am pe toţi cei vii care merg sub soare îmbulzindu-se lângă tânărul care va sta în locul regelui ca moştenitor.
translations.grk: Εἶδον σύμπαντας τοὺς ζῶντας τοὺς περιπατοῦντας ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον μετὰ τοῦ νεανίσκου τοῦ δευτέρου, ὃς στήσεται ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ኮኑ፡ እምቅድሜሁ፡ እስመ፡ ደኃርትኒ፡ ኢይትፌሥሑ፡ ቦቱ፡ እስመ፡ ዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: There is no end to all the people, to all who were before them: and the last shall not rejoice in him: for this also is vanity and waywardness of spirit.

translations.lxx: There is no end to all the people, to all who were before them: and the last shall not rejoice in him: for this also is vanity and waywardness of spirit.
translations.kjv: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: Şi nu se mai sfârşea poporul în fruntea căruia era; totuşi urmaşii lui nu se vor bucura de el. Şi aceasta este deşertăciune şi vânare de vânt.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔστι περασμὸς τῷ παντὶ λαῷ, τοῖς πᾶσιν οἳ ἐγένοντο ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν· καί γε οἱ ἔσχατοι οὐκ εὐφρανθήσονται ἐπʼ αὐτῷ· ὅτι καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος.
